name: distortion-traps
description: Every claim lands, and one of them lands altered. A transcript that restates a claim two days later rewrites the stored validity anchor and confidence of the row already on file, so a text-only match reports perfect recall over a ledger that no longer says what the speaker said.
note: The mechanism is two shipped behaviours meeting: the restatement collapse finds the live claim (facts.ts:456) and refreshClaim (facts.ts:640) then COALESCEs the new valid_from and confidence over the old ones. The claim was made on the 16th and repeated on the 18th; the ledger ends up dating it to the 18th at the repeat's lower confidence. That is what distortionRate is for — the claim is present, matchable, and no longer accurate about when it was made or how sure the speaker was. It is a known consequence of two correct paths, not a defect, which is why this fixture pins it rather than failing it.
